lines.text: Issachar had four sons, and Tola's descendants were counted as mighty men of valor in the days of Moses.
Ezer and Elead were killed by the natives of Gath, and Ephraim mourned many days.
Ephraim's daughter Sheerah built Lower and Upper Beth-horon, and Nun's son was Caleb.
The chiefs according to their genealogies lived in Jerusalem, and Jeiel the father of Gibeon lived in Gibeon.
Kish was the father of Saul, and the sons of Ulam were mighty men of valor, archers.
